demo: rise vs raise vs arise vs arouse (四级常客):¶rise    vi 升起    The sun rises in the east.¶raise  vt 举起/抚养  raise your hand / raise kids¶arise  vi 产生    problems arise¶arouse vt 激发    arouse one's interest¶记忆: 有 a 后接宾语的是及物(raise/arouse)
affect vs effect 词性定生死:¶affect  动词  The news affected me deeply.¶effect  名词  have an effect on sth¶侧脸技巧: e(x)ffect 里藏名词性(e- 结尾多名词); affect 以 a 开头 = action = 动作 = 动词
fit / suit / match 三兄弟:¶fit   尺寸合身   The jacket fits me perfectly.¶suit  风格衬托   The color suits you.¶match 物物相配   The tie matches the suit.¶送人穿: fit 像不像, suit 好不好看, match 配不配套
着手做某事 两种写法不能混:¶set out to do sth   The team set out to prove the theory.¶set about doing sth  He set about tidying the room.¶口诀: out 接 to, about 接 ing¶同类: set up 建立 / set off 出发引爆 / set aside 留出搁置
to 是介词(后接 doing)的高频短语:¶look forward to doing   期待做某事¶be used to doing         习惯于做某事¶pay attention to doing   注意做某事¶object to doing / be committed to doing¶对比: used to do(过去常常)与 be used to doing(习惯)
定语从句关系词速查:¶从句缺主语/宾语 + 指物 → that / which¶从句缺主语/宾语 + 指人 → who / that¶从句不缺成分 + 地点  → where¶从句不缺成分 + 时间  → when¶空后有名词(所属关系)   → whose¶有逗号(非限定) 不能用 that, 也不能用 who 指物

wish 的三种时间对照:¶对现在遗憾  wish + 过去式     I wish I were taller.¶对过去遗憾  wish + had done    I wish I had told him.¶对将来无望  wish + would do    I wish it would stop raining.¶对比: hope + 将来真实可能 I hope it will be fine.

more than 家族四兄弟:¶no more than     = only        只不过(数量少)¶not more than     = at most     不超过(上限)¶no less than      = as much as  多达(强调多)¶not...any more than = 与…一样不…  前后一起否定¶例句: A man is not happy any more than he is perfect.
中式连词成对, 英文只留一个:¶因为…所以  Because..., I...  /  ..., so I...¶虽然…但是  Although..., he...  /  ..., but he...¶注意: though/although 可与 still 同现, but 不可与 although 同现¶检验法: 一句里出现两个从属/并列连词翻译同一个逻辑→删一个
贵 / 便宜 的主语分工:¶物 + expensive / cheap     The house is expensive.¶价格 + high / low          The price of the house is high.¶中文「价格很贵」是典型 Chinglish¶同类: 人口多用 large, 少用 small(不说 many people 时注意可数)

the 的加与不加:¶乐器前加 the:  play the guitar / play the piano¶球类棋类不加: play basketball / play chess¶江河海洋山脉加 the: the Yangtze, the Pacific¶单座山/单湖/街道/城市不加: Mount Tai, Fifth Avenue¶一日三餐不加: have breakfast(不加 a/the)

影响 / 作用 / 重要性 三组书面搭配:¶have/exert an impact on   对…有影响(动词只有 have/exert)¶have an effect on / an influence on¶play a vital role in        在…起关键作用¶be vital / essential to     对…至关重要¶易错: 不说 make an impact, 不说 do a role
